      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kyle Huntingdon_, Nov 8, 2026, 1/5: "I was enjoying the app but it started crashing. They had me load an old version of the app but when I cancelled on the old version I still got billed the full amount today and cannot find a support function to get this fixed. I liked it when it worked but it's turning into a scam."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, May 23, 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Stacey Brown_, Nov 4, 2026, 2/5: "I am giving this a two because it is a very frustrating app! I just want to open it and click workout but it won't let me! The lag time on this app is insane and it demands that I turn on notifications but I don't want to turn on notifications. Even though there is an X that I should be able to exit the pop-up, It will not let me move on and actually let me work out! I find that this app is more of a discouragement than an encouragement for me to workout!"
